data.long_meaning: The name Hayley is derived from the Hebrew name 'Hay' which means 'rock' and the Old English name 'Ley' which means 'meadow'. Together, the name Hayley can be interpreted as a strong, feminine name meaning 'rock meadow'. The name Hayley carries the meaning “Rock meadow” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hayley usually hope their child will grow to embody rock meadow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
